verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new PR in selected repos (graphite-docs-4, graphite-docs-19). Custom rules let teams define explicit guidelines for that review, with comment exclusions also configurable (graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-20, graphite-docs-33). The evidence shows these rules shaping review comments, not as discrete pre-merge checks that pass, fail or gate merging. missing for 10: evidence that custom rules are written in plain language with examples like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', evidence that rules report as pass/fail status checks that block merge, independent or hands-on corroboration.
